question: Where is the nearest restaurant while traveling toward Jakes Rock Overlook and Mountain Bike Trail, Tidioute, PA from Main Street Art, Girard, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.318615 42.000159)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.348409 41.636215)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.318615 42.000159)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.318615 42.000159)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Jakes Rock Overlook and Mountain Bike Trail, Tidioute, PA

poi.poi_name: Jakes Rock Overlook and Mountain Bike Trail
